arabic: رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلۡ مِنَّآۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
transliteration: Rabbanaa taqabbal minnaa; innaka Antas Samee'ul Aleem
translation: Our Lord! Accept this from us. You are indeed the All-Hearing, All-Knowing.

arabic: رَبَّنَا وَٱجۡعَلۡنَا مُسۡلِمَيۡنِ لَكَ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِنَآ أُمَّةٗ مُّسۡلِمَةٗ لَّكَ وَأَرِنَا مَنَاسِكَنَا وَتُبۡ عَلَيۡنَآۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلتَّوَّابُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
transliteration: Rabbanaa waj'alnaa muslimaini laka wa-min zurriyyatinaaa ummatam muslimatal laka wa-arinaa manaasikanaa wa-tub alainaa; innaka antat Tawwaabur Raheem
translation: Our Lord! Make us both fully submit to You1 and from our descendants a nation that will submit to You. Show us our rituals, and turn to us in grace. You are truly the Accepter of Repentance, Most Merciful.

arabic: رَبَّنَآ ءَاتِنَا فِي ٱلدُّنۡيَا حَسَنَةٗ وَفِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ حَسَنَةٗ وَقِنَا عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ
transliteration: Rabbanaaa aatina fid dunyaa hasanatanw wa-fil aakhirati hasanatanw wa-qinaa azaaban Naar
translation: Our Lord! Grant us the good of this world and the Hereafter, and protect us from the torment of the Fire.

arabic: رَبَّنَآ أَفۡرِغۡ عَلَيۡنَا صَبۡرٗا وَثَبِّتۡ أَقۡدَامَنَا وَٱنصُرۡنَا عَلَى ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
transliteration: Rabbanaaa afrigh alainaa sabranw wa-sabbit aqdaamanaa wansurnaa 'alal qawmil kaafireen
translation: Our Lord! Shower us with perseverance, make our steps firm, and give us victory over the disbelieving people.”

arabic: رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحۡمِلۡ عَلَيۡنَآ إِصۡرٗا كَمَا حَمَلۡتَهُۥ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِنَاۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلۡنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِۦۖ وَٱعۡفُ عَنَّا وَٱغۡفِرۡ لَنَا وَٱرۡحَمۡنَآۚ أَنتَ مَوۡلَىٰنَا فَٱنصُرۡنَا عَلَى ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ ٢٨٦
transliteration: Rabbanaa wa-laa tuhammilnaa maa laa taaqata lanaa bih(i); wa'fu 'annaa waghfir lanaa warhamnaa, Anta mawlaanaa fansurnaa 'alal qawmil kaafireen
translation: Our Lord! Do not punish us if we forget or make a mistake. Our Lord! Do not place a burden on us like the one you placed on those before us. Our Lord! Do not burden us with what we cannot bear. Pardon us, forgive us, and have mercy on us. You are our only Guardian. So grant us victory over the disbelieving people.”

arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغۡ قُلُوبَنَا بَعۡدَ إِذۡ هَدَيۡتَنَا وَهَبۡ لَنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحۡمَةًۚ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلۡوَهَّابُ ٨
transliteration: Rabbanaa laa tuzigh quloobanaa ba'da iz hadaitanaa wa-hab lanaa mil ladunka rahmah,(tan) innaka antal Wahhaab
translation: Our Lord! Do not let our hearts deviate after you have guided us. Grant us Your mercy. You are indeed the Giver of all bounties.

arabic: رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ جَامِعُ ٱلنَّاسِ لِيَوۡمٖ لَّا رَيۡبَ فِيهِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُخۡلِفُ ٱلۡمِيعَادَ
transliteration: Rabbanaaa innaka jaami'un naasi li-Yawmil laa raiba feeh,(i) innal laaha laa yukhliful mee'aad
translation: Our Lord! You will certainly gather all humanity for the promised Day

arabic: رَبَّنَآ إِنَّنَآ ءَامَنَّا فَٱغۡفِرۡ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَقِنَا عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ
transliteration: Rabbanaaa innanaaa aamannaa faghfir lanaa zunoobanaa wa-qinaa 'azaaban Naar
translation: “Our Lord! We have believed, so forgive our sins and protect us from the torment of the Fire.”

arabic: رَبَّنَآ ءَامَنَّا بِمَآ أَنزَلۡتَ وَٱتَّبَعۡنَا ٱلرَّسُولَ فَٱكۡتُبۡنَا مَعَ ٱلشَّٰهِدِينَ
transliteration: Rabbanaaa aamannaa bimaaa anzalta wattaba'nar Rasoola faktubnaa ma'ash shaahideen
translation: Our Lord! We believe in Your revelations and follow the messenger, so count us among those who bear witness.

arabic: رَبِّ هَبۡ لِي مِن لَّدُنكَ ذُرِّيَّةٗ طَيِّبَةًۖ إِنَّكَ سَمِيعُ ٱلدُّعَآءِ
transliteration: Rabbi hab lee mil ladunka zurriyyatan taiyiba(tan); innaka samee'ud du'aaa'
translation: My Lord! Grant me

arabic: رَبَّنَا ٱغۡفِرۡ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَإِسۡرَافَنَا فِيٓ أَمۡرِنَا وَثَبِّتۡ أَقۡدَامَنَا وَٱنصُرۡنَا عَلَى ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
transliteration: Rabbanagh fir lanaa zunoobanaa Wa-israafanaa feee amrinaa Wa-sabbit aqdaamanaa wansurnaa 'alal qawmil kaafireen
translation: Our Lord! Forgive our sins and excesses, make our steps firm, and grant us victory over the disbelieving people.

arabic: رَبَّنَا مَا خَلَقۡتَ هَٰذَا بَٰطِلٗا سُبۡحَٰنَكَ فَقِنَا عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ
transliteration: Rabbanaa maa khalaqta haaza baatila(n) Subhaanaka faqinaa 'azaaban Naar
translation: Our Lord! You have not created all of this without purpose. Glory be to You! Protect us from the torment of the Fire.

arabic: رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ مَن تُدۡخِلِ ٱلنَّارَ فَقَدۡ أَخۡزَيۡتَهُۥۖ وَمَا لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ مِنۡ أَنصَارٖ
transliteration: Rabbanaaa innaka man tud-khilin Naara faqad akhzai-tah(oo); Wa-maa liz-zaalimeena min ansaar
translation: Our Lord! Indeed, those You commit to the Fire will be completely disgraced! And the wrongdoers will have no helpers.

arabic: رَّبَّنَآ إِنَّنَا سَمِعۡنَا مُنَادِيٗا يُنَادِي لِلۡإِيمَٰنِ أَنۡ ءَامِنُواْ بِرَبِّكُمۡ فَـَٔامَنَّاۚ رَبَّنَا فَٱغۡفِرۡ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَكَفِّرۡ عَنَّا سَيِّـَٔاتِنَا وَتَوَفَّنَا مَعَ ٱلۡأَبۡرَارِ
transliteration: Rabbanaaa innanaa sami'naa munaa-di-yaien yunaadee lil-eemaani an aaminoo bi-Rabbikum fa-aamannaa, Rabbanaa faghfir lanaa zunoobanaa Wa-kaffir 'annaa saiyi-aatina Wa-tawaffanaa ma'al abraar
translation: Our Lord! We have heard the caller1 to true belief, proclaiming, ‘Believe in your Lord alone,’ so we believed. Our Lord! Forgive our sins, absolve us of our misdeeds, and join us with the virtuous when we die‎.

arabic: رَبَّنَا وَءَاتِنَا مَا وَعَدتَّنَا عَلَىٰ رُسُلِكَ وَلَا تُخۡزِنَا يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِۖ إِنَّكَ لَا تُخۡلِفُ ٱلۡمِيعَادَ ١٩٤
transliteration: Rabbanaa Wa-aatinaa maa wa'adt-tanaa 'alaa Rusulika Wa-laa tukhzinaa Yawmal Qiyaama(h):(ti) innaka laa tukhliful mee'aad
translation: Our Lord! Grant us what You have promised us through Your messengers and do not put us to shame on Judgment Day

arabic: رَبَّنَآ أَخۡرِجۡنَا مِنۡ هَٰذِهِ ٱلۡقَرۡيَةِ ٱلظَّالِمِ أَهۡلُهَا وَٱجۡعَل لَّنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ وَلِيّٗا وَٱجۡعَل لَّنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ نَصِيرًا ٧٥
transliteration: Rabbanaaa akhrijnaa min haazihil qaryatiz zaalimi ahluhaa waj'al lanaa mil ladunka waliyanw waj'al lanaa mil ladunka naseeraa
translation: And what is it with you? You do not fight in the cause of Allah and for oppressed men, women, and children who cry out, “Our Lord! Deliver us from this land of oppressors! Appoint for us a saviour; appoint for us a helper

arabic: رَبَّنَآ ءَامَنَّا فَٱكۡتُبۡنَا مَعَ ٱلشَّٰهِدِينَ ٨٣
transliteration: Rabbanaa aamannaa faktubnaa ma'ash shaahideen
translation: Our Lord! We believe, so count us among the witnesses.

arabic: رَبَّنَآ أَنزِلۡ عَلَيۡنَا مَآئِدَةٗ مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ تَكُونُ لَنَا عِيدٗا لِّأَوَّلِنَا وَءَاخِرِنَا وَءَايَةٗ مِّنكَۖ وَٱرۡزُقۡنَا وَأَنتَ خَيۡرُ ٱلرَّٰزِقِينَ
transliteration: Rabbanaaa anzil alainaa maaa'idatam minas samaaa'(i) takoonu lanaa 'eedal li-awwalinaa Wa-aakhirinaa Wa-Aayatam minka warzuqnaa Wa-Anta khairur raaziqeen
translation: O Allah, our Lord! Send us from heaven a table spread with food as a feast for us

arabic: رَبَّنَا ظَلَمۡنَآ أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمۡ تَغۡفِرۡ لَنَا وَتَرۡحَمۡنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلۡخَٰسِرِينَ ٢٣
transliteration: Rabbanaa zalamnaaa anfusanaa Wa-il lam taghfir lanaa Wa-tarhamnaa lana-koo-nanna minal khaasireen
translation: Our Lord! We have wronged ourselves. If You do not forgive us and have mercy on us, we will certainly be losers.”

arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجۡعَلۡنَا مَعَ ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
transliteration: Rabbanaa laa taj'alnaa ma'al qawmiz zaalimeen
translation: Our Lord! Do not join us with the wrongdoing people.

arabic: رَبَّنَا ٱفۡتَحۡ بَيۡنَنَا وَبَيۡنَ قَوۡمِنَا بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَأَنتَ خَيۡرُ ٱلۡفَٰتِحِينَ ٨٩
transliteration: Rabbanaf tah bainanaa Wa-baina qawminaa bilhaqqi Wa-Anta khairul faatiheen
translation: We would surely be fabricating a lie against Allah if we were to return to your faith after Allah has saved us from it. It does not befit us to return to it unless it is the Will of Allah, our Lord. Our Lord has encompassed everything in His knowledge. In Allah we trust. Our Lord! Judge between us and our people with truth. You are the best of those who judge.”

arabic: رَبَّنَآ أَفۡرِغۡ عَلَيۡنَا صَبۡرٗا وَتَوَفَّنَا مُسۡلِمِينَ ١٢٦
transliteration: Rabbanaaa afrigh alainaa sabranw Wa-tawaffanaa muslimeen
translation: Our Lord! Shower us with perseverance, and let us die while submitting to You.

arabic: رَبِّ ٱغۡفِرۡ لِي وَلِأَخِي وَأَدۡخِلۡنَا فِي رَحۡمَتِكَۖ وَأَنتَ أَرۡحَمُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ ١٥١
transliteration: Rabbigh fir lee Wa-li-akhee Wa-adkhilnaa fee rahmatika Wa-Anta arhamur raahimeen
translation: My Lord! Forgive me and my brother! And admit us into Your mercy. You are the Most Merciful of the merciful.”

arabic: حَسۡبُنَا ٱللَّهُ سَيُؤۡتِينَا ٱللَّهُ مِن فَضۡلِهِۦ وَرَسُولُهُۥٓ إِنَّآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ رَٰغِبُونَ
transliteration: Hasbunal laahu sayu'teenal laahu min fadlihee Wa-Rasooluhooo innaaa ilal laahi raaghiboon
translation: Allah is sufficient for us! Allah will grant us out of His bounty, and so will His Messenger. To Allah alone we turn with hope.”

arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجۡعَلۡنَا فِتۡنَةٗ لِّلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ ٨٥
transliteration: Rabbanaa laa taj'alnaa fitnatal lilqawmiz zaalimeen
translation: In Allah we trust. Our Lord! Do not subject us to the persecution of the oppressive people,

arabic: وَنَجِّنَا بِرَحۡمَتِكَ مِنَ ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ ٨٦
transliteration: Wa-najjinaa birahmatika minal qawmil kaafireen
translation: and deliver us by Your mercy from the disbelieving people.”

arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّيٓ أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنۡ أَسۡـَٔلَكَ مَا لَيۡسَ لِي بِهِۦ عِلۡمٞۖ وَإِلَّا تَغۡفِرۡ لِي وَتَرۡحَمۡنِيٓ أَكُن مِّنَ ٱلۡخَٰسِرِينَ ٤٧
transliteration: Rabbi inneee a'oozu bika an as'alaka maa laisa lee bihee ilmunw Wa-illaa taghfir lee Wa-tarhamneee akum minal khaasireen
translation: My Lord, I seek refuge in You from asking You about what I have no knowledge of, and unless You forgive me and have mercy on me, I will be one of the losers.”

arabic: ۞رَبِّ قَدۡ ءَاتَيۡتَنِي مِنَ ٱلۡمُلۡكِ وَعَلَّمۡتَنِي مِن تَأۡوِيلِ ٱلۡأَحَادِيثِۚ فَاطِرَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ أَنتَ وَلِيِّۦ فِي ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَٱلۡأٓخِرَةِۖ تَوَفَّنِي مُسۡلِمٗا وَأَلۡحِقۡنِي بِٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ ١٠١
transliteration: Rabbi qad aataitanee minal mulki Wa-'allamtanee min taaweelil ahaadees; faati-ras samaawaati wal-ardi Anta waliyyee fid dunyaa wal-Aakhirati tawaffanee muslimanw Wa-alhiqnee bissaaliheen
translation: “My Lord! You have surely granted me authority and taught me the interpretation of dreams. O Originator of the heavens and the earth! You are my Guardian in this world and the Hereafter. Allow me to die as one who submits1 and join me with the righteous.”

arabic: قَالَ إِبۡرَٰهِيمُ رَبِّ ٱجۡعَلۡ هَٰذَا ٱلۡبَلَدَ ءَامِنٗا وَٱجۡنُبۡنِي وَبَنِيَّ أَن نَّعۡبُدَ ٱلۡأَصۡنَامَ ٣٥
transliteration: Qaala ibraaheemu Rabbij 'al haazal balada aaminanw wajnubnee Wa-baniyya an na'budal asnaam
translation: My Lord! Make this city of Mecca secure, and keep me and my children away from the worship of idols.

arabic: رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ تَعۡلَمُ مَا نُخۡفِي وَمَا نُعۡلِنُۗ وَمَا يَخۡفَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ مِن شَيۡءٖ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَا فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ ٣٨
transliteration: Rabbanaaa innaka ta'lamu maa nukhfee Wa-maa nu'lin; Wa-maa yakhfaa 'alal laahi min shai'in fil ardi Wa-laa fis samaaa'
translation: Our Lord! You certainly know what we conceal and what we reveal. Nothing on earth or in heaven is hidden from Allah.

arabic: رَبِّ ٱجۡعَلۡنِي مُقِيمَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِيۚ رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلۡ دُعَآءِ ٤٠
transliteration: Rabbij 'alnee muqeemas Salaati Wa-min zurriyyatee Rabbanaa Wa-taqabbal du'aaa'
translation: My Lord! Make me and those believers of my descendants keep up prayer. Our Lord! Accept my prayers.

arabic: رَبَّنَا ٱغۡفِرۡ لِي وَلِوَٰلِدَيَّ وَلِلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ يَوۡمَ يَقُومُ ٱلۡحِسَابُ ٤١
transliteration: Rabbanagh fir lee Wa-liwaalidaiya Wa-lilmu'mineena Yawma yaqoomul hisaab
translation: Our Lord! Forgive me, my parents, and the believers on the Day when the judgment will come to pass.”

arabic: رَّبِّ ٱرۡحَمۡهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِي صَغِيرٗا ٢٤
transliteration: Rabbir hamhumaa kamaa rabbayaanee sagheera
translation: My Lord! Be merciful to them as they raised me when I was young.

arabic: رَّبِّ أَدۡخِلۡنِي مُدۡخَلَ صِدۡقٖ وَأَخۡرِجۡنِي مُخۡرَجَ صِدۡقٖ وَٱجۡعَل لِّي مِن لَّدُنكَ سُلۡطَٰنٗا نَّصِيرٗا ٨٠
transliteration: Rabbi adkhilnee mudkhala sidqinw Wa-akhrijnee mukhraja sidqinw waj'al lee mil ladunka sultaanan naseeraa
translation: My Lord! Grant me an honourable entrance and an honourable exit1 and give me a supporting authority from Yourself.

arabic: رَبَّنَآ ءَاتِنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحۡمَةٗ وَهَيِّئۡ لَنَا مِنۡ أَمۡرِنَا رَشَدٗا ١٠
transliteration: Rabbanaaa aatinaa mil ladunka rahmatanw Wa-haiyi' lanaa min amrinaa rashadaa
translation: Our Lord! Grant us mercy from Yourself and guide us rightly through our ordeal.

arabic: رَبُّنَا رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ لَن نَّدۡعُوَاْ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ إِلَٰهٗاۖ لَّقَدۡ قُلۡنَآ إِذٗا شَطَطًا ١٤
transliteration: Rabbunaa Rabbus samaawaati wal-ardi lan nad'uwa min dooniheee ilaahal laqad qulnaaa izan shatataa
translation: Our Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth. We will never call upon any god besides Him, or we would truly be uttering an outrageous lie.”

arabic: رَبِّ ٱشۡرَحۡ لِي صَدۡرِي ٢٥
transliteration: Rabbish rah lee sadree
translation: My Lord! Uplift my heart for me

arabic: وَيَسِّرۡ لِيٓ أَمۡرِي ٢٦
transliteration: Wa-yassir leee amree
translation: and make my task easy,

arabic: وَٱحۡلُلۡ عُقۡدَةٗ مِّن لِّسَانِي ٢٧
transliteration: Wahlul 'uqdatan milli saanee
translation: and remove the impediment from my tongue

arabic: يَفۡقَهُواْ قَوۡلِي ٢٨
transliteration: Yafqahoo qawlee
translation: so people may understand my speech,1

arabic: رَبَّنَآ إِنَّنَا نَخَافُ أَن يَفۡرُطَ عَلَيۡنَآ أَوۡ أَن يَطۡغَىٰ ٤٥
transliteration: Rabbanaaa innanaa nakhaafu aien yafruta alainaaa aw ai yatghaa
translation: Our Lord! We fear that he may be quick to harm us or act tyrannically.

arabic: رَّبِّ زِدۡنِي عِلۡمٗا
transliteration: Rabbi zidnee ilmaa
translation: “My Lord! Increase me in knowledge.”

arabic: لَّآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنتَ سُبۡحَٰنَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ ٨٧
transliteration: Wa-Zan Nooni iz zahaba mughaadiban fa-zannaa al lan naqdira alaihi fanaadaa fiz zulumaati al laaa ilaaha illaaa Anta Subhaanaka innee kuntu minaz zaalimeen
translation: “There is no god worthy of worship except You. Glory be to You! I have certainly done wrong.”

arabic: رَبِّ لَا تَذَرۡنِي فَرۡدٗا وَأَنتَ خَيۡرُ ٱلۡوَٰرِثِينَ ٨٩
transliteration: Rabbi laa tazarnee fardanw Wa-Anta khairul waariseen
translation: My Lord! Do not leave me childless, though You are the Best of Successors.”1

arabic: رَّبِّ أَنزِلۡنِي مُنزَلٗا مُّبَارَكٗا وَأَنتَ خَيۡرُ ٱلۡمُنزِلِينَ ٢٩
transliteration: Rabbi anzilnee munzalam mubaarakanw Wa-Anta khairul munzileen
translation: My Lord! Allow me a blessed landing, for You are the best accommodator.”

arabic: رَبِّ فَلَا تَجۡعَلۡنِي فِي ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ ٩٤
transliteration: Rabbi falaa taj'alnee fil qawmiz zaalimeen
translation: My Lord, do not count me among the wrongdoing people.”

arabic: رَّبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنۡ هَمَزَٰتِ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينِ ٩٧
transliteration: Rabbi a'oozu bika min hamazaatish Shayaateen
translation: My Lord! I seek refuge in You from the temptations of the devils.

arabic: رَبَّنَآ ءَامَنَّا فَٱغۡفِرۡ لَنَا وَٱرۡحَمۡنَا وَأَنتَ خَيۡرُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ ١٠٩
transliteration: Rabbanaaa aamannaa faghfir lanaa warhamnaa Wa-Anta khairur raahimeen
translation: Our Lord! We have believed, so forgive us and have mercy on us, for You are the best of those who show mercy

arabic: رَّبِّ ٱغۡفِرۡ وَٱرۡحَمۡ وَأَنتَ خَيۡرُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ ١١٨
transliteration: Rabbigh fir warham Wa-Anta khairur raahimeen
translation: My Lord! Forgive and have mercy, for You are the best of those who show mercy.”

arabic: ٱصۡرِفۡ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَۖ إِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَامًا ٦٥
transliteration: Rabbanas rif 'annaa 'azaaba Jahannama inna 'azaabahaa kaana gharaamaa
translation: Our Lord! Keep the punishment of Hell away from us, for its punishment is indeed unrelenting.

arabic: رَبَّنَا هَبۡ لَنَا مِنۡ أَزۡوَٰجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّٰتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعۡيُنٖ وَٱجۡعَلۡنَا لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا ٧٤
transliteration: Rabbanaa hab lanaa min azwaajinaa Wa-zurriyaatinaa qurrata a'yuninw waj-'alnaa lilmuttaqeena imaamaa
translation: Our Lord! Bless us with pious spouses and offspring who will be the joy of our hearts, and make us models for the righteous.

arabic: رَبِّ أَوۡزِعۡنِيٓ أَنۡ أَشۡكُرَ نِعۡمَتَكَ ٱلَّتِيٓ أَنۡعَمۡتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَٰلِدَيَّ وَأَنۡ أَعۡمَلَ صَٰلِحٗا تَرۡضَىٰهُ وَأَدۡخِلۡنِي بِرَحۡمَتِكَ فِي عِبَادِكَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ ١٩
transliteration: Rabbi awzi'nee an ashkura ni'mata-kal lateee an'amta alaiyya Wa-'alaa waalidaiyya Wa-an a'mala saalihan tardaahu Wa-adkhilnee birahmatika fee ibaadikas saaliheen
translation: My Lord! Inspire me to always be thankful for Your favours which You have blessed me and my parents with, and to do good deeds that please you. Admit me, by Your mercy, into the company of Your righteous servants.”

arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي ظَلَمۡتُ نَفۡسِي فَٱغۡفِرۡ لِي فَغَفَرَ لَهُۥٓۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ ١٦
transliteration: aala Rabbi innee zalamtu nafsee faghfir lee faghafara lah; innahoo Huwal Ghafoorur Raheem
translation: My Lord! I have definitely wronged my soul, so forgive me.” So He forgave him, for He is indeed the All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

arabic: رَبِّ نَجِّنِي مِنَ ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ ٢١
transliteration: Rabbi najjinee minal qawmiz zaalimeen
translation: My Lord! Deliver me from the wrongdoing people.”

arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي لِمَآ أَنزَلۡتَ إِلَيَّ مِنۡ خَيۡرٖ فَقِيرٞ ٢٤
transliteration: Rabbi innee limaaa anzalta ilaiya min khairin faqeer
translation: My Lord! I am truly in desperate need of whatever provision You may have in store for me.

arabic: رَبِّ ٱنصُرۡنِي عَلَى ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلۡمُفۡسِدِينَ ٣٠
transliteration: Rabbin surnee 'alal qawmil mufsideen
translation: My Lord! Help me against the people of corruption.

arabic: رَبِّ هَبۡ لِي مِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ ١٠٠
transliteration: Rabbi hab lee minas saaliheen
translation: My Lord! Bless me with righteous offspring.”

arabic: رَبَّنَا وَسِعۡتَ كُلَّ شَيۡءٖ رَّحۡمَةٗ وَعِلۡمٗا فَٱغۡفِرۡ لِلَّذِينَ تَابُواْ وَٱتَّبَعُواْ سَبِيلَكَ وَقِهِمۡ عَذَابَ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ ٧
transliteration: Rabbanaa wasi'ta kulla shai'ir rahmatanw Wa-'ilman faghfir lillazeena taaboo wattaba'oo sabeelaka Wa-qihim 'azaabal Jaheem
translation: “Our Lord! You encompass everything in Your mercy and knowledge. So forgive those who repent and follow Your Way, and protect them from the torment of the Hellfire.

arabic: رَبَّنَا وَأَدۡخِلۡهُمۡ جَنَّٰتِ عَدۡنٍ ٱلَّتِي وَعَدتَّهُمۡ وَمَن صَلَحَ مِنۡ ءَابَآئِهِمۡ وَأَزۡوَٰجِهِمۡ وَذُرِّيَّٰتِهِمۡۚ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ ٨
transliteration: Rabbanaa Wa-adkhilhum Jannaati adninil latee wa'attahum Wa-man salaha min aabaaa'ihim Wa-azwaajihim Wa-zurriyyaatihim; innaka Antal 'Azeezul Hakeem
translation: Our Lord! Admit them into the Gardens of Eternity which You have promised them, along with the righteous among their parents, spouses, and descendants. You alone are truly the Almighty, All-Wise.

arabic: رَبِّ أَوۡزِعۡنِيٓ أَنۡ أَشۡكُرَ نِعۡمَتَكَ ٱلَّتِيٓ أَنۡعَمۡتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَٰلِدَيَّ وَأَنۡ أَعۡمَلَ صَٰلِحٗا تَرۡضَىٰهُ وَأَصۡلِحۡ لِي فِي ذُرِّيَّتِيٓۖ إِنِّي تُبۡتُ إِلَيۡكَ وَإِنِّي مِنَ ٱلۡمُسۡلِمِينَ ٥
transliteration: Rabbi awzi'-neee an ashkura ni'matakal lateee an'amta alaiyya Wa-'alaa waalidaiya Wa-an a'mala saalihan tardaahu Wa-aslih lee fee zurriyyatee; innee tubtu ilaika Wa-innee minal muslimeen
translation: My Lord! Inspire me to always be thankful for Your favours which You blessed me and my parents with, and to do good deeds that please You. And instil righteousness in my offspring. I truly repent to You, and I truly submit to Your Will.”

arabic: رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ رَءُوفٞ رَّحِيمٌ ١٠
transliteration: Rabbannaaa innaka Ra'oofur Raheem
translation: Our Lord! Forgive us and our fellow believers who preceded us in faith, and do not allow bitterness into our hearts towards those who believe. Our Lord! Indeed, You are Ever Gracious, Most Merciful.”

arabic: رَّبَّنَا عَلَيۡكَ تَوَكَّلۡنَا وَإِلَيۡكَ أَنَبۡنَا وَإِلَيۡكَ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ ٤
transliteration: Rabbanaa alaika tawakkalnaa Wa-ilaika anabnaa Wa-ilaikal maseer
translation: “Our Lord! In You we trust. And to You we always turn. And to You is the final return.

arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجۡعَلۡنَا فِتۡنَةٗ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَٱغۡفِرۡ لَنَا رَبَّنَآۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ ٥
transliteration: Rabbana laa taj'alnaa fitnatal lillazeena kafaroo waghfir lanaa rabbanaa innaka antal azeezul hakeem
translation: Our Lord! Do not subject us to the persecution of the disbelievers. Forgive us, our Lord! You alone are truly the Almighty, All-Wise.”

arabic: رَبَّنَآ أَتۡمِمۡ لَنَا نُورَنَا وَٱغۡفِرۡ لَنَآۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٞ ٨
transliteration: Rabbanaaa atmim lanaa nooranaa waghfir lana innaka 'alaa kulli shai'in qadeer
translation: Our Lord! Perfect our light for us, and forgive us. For You are truly Most Capable of everything.”

arabic: رَبِّ ٱبۡنِ لِي عِندَكَ بَيۡتٗا فِي ٱلۡجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِي مِن فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَعَمَلِهِۦ وَنَجِّنِي مِنَ ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ ١١
transliteration: rab-bib ni lee indaka baitan fil jannati Wa-najjinee min Fir'awna Wa-'amalihee Wa-najjinee minal qawmiz zaalimeen
translation: My Lord! Build me a house in Paradise near You, deliver me from Pharaoh and his evil doing, and save me from the wrongdoing people.”

arabic: رَّبِّ ٱغۡفِرۡ لِي وَلِوَٰلِدَيَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيۡتِيَ مُؤۡمِنٗا وَلِلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنَٰتِۖ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا تَبَارَۢا ٢٨
transliteration: Rabbigh fir lee Wa-liwaa-lidaiya Wa-liman dakhala baitiya mu'minanw Wa-lil-mu'mineena wal-mu'minaati Wa-laa tazidiz zaalimeena illaa tabaaraa
translation: My Lord! Forgive me, my parents, and whoever enters my house in faith, and all believing men and women. And increase the wrongdoers only in destruction.”
